fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling Los Lunas, ~160,000 sq ft bottled-water plant opened 2016 in Los Morros Business Park, NW of NM-6 / I-25. Confirmed by 'niagara bottling LLC' monument sign at the truck gate in Street View (2026-03).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence with sliding gate; a striped barrier arm is visible lowered across the entry drive in Street View, with yellow bollards channeling traffic.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No manned multi-window guard booth at the entry lane. Small tan structures near the gate are utility/equipment enclosures set back behind the fence, not staffed booths.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Barrier arm + bollards with no manned booth implies kiosk / automated / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Approx 16 - counted ~6-8 trailers backed into the west face plus additional doors; some of the west face is obscured by parked trailers. Low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and ample unused width inside the fence to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Long row of nose-out parked trailers along the west side plus trailers staged along the north edge - dedicated trailer storage separate from active dock apron.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town desert business park, isolated; adjacent Meta data center and Walmart DC but broadly open desert. Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large white-roofed manufacturing building. The dark structure to the SE is a solar-panel carport over employee parking, not a separate building.
